lines.t: Fearless, fearless, glow
With YahuShua, let it show
City lights are cold, shadows on my face
Chasing empty dreams, lost in empty space
Then Your voice broke through, called me by my name
Now I’m running free, nothing stays the same
Heart is beating faster, feel the fire rise
Chains are falling off, see the truth in my eyes
From the dark to light, I was made to shine
Fearless glow, with YahuShua I rise
Brighter than the stars, shining in His eyes
Every step I dance, every fear I leave
Fearless glow, YahuShua in me
(Oh‑oh‑oh) Fearless glow!
(Oh‑oh‑oh) Let it show!
Used to hide my scars, now they tell Your story
Every broken piece, now it sings Your glory
No more looking back, future calls my name
With Your power in me, nothing looks the same
Heart is beating faster, feel the fire rise
Chains are falling off, see the truth in my eyes
From the dark to light, I was made to shine
Fearless glow, with YahuShua I rise
Brighter than the stars, shining in His eyes
Every step I dance, every fear I leave
Fearless glow, YahuShua in me
(Oh‑oh‑oh) Fearless glow!
(Oh‑oh‑oh) Let it show!
Yo, I was lost in the crowd, now I’m standing tall
YahuShua called my name, answered every call
No more fake, no more chains, living for the King
Light inside me bursting, watch the whole world sing
From the ashes to the throne, chosen, not alone
Fearless with His power, now the stage is home
Fearless glow, with YahuShua I rise (I rise!)
Brighter than the stars, shining in His eyes
Every step I dance, every fear I leave
Fearless glow, YahuShua in me
Fearless glow! (Oh‑oh‑oh)
Fearless glow! (Let it show!)
Fearless, fearless, glow
With YahuShua, let it show
